checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals web-experience-direction, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals web-experience-direction.

checks.description: The output sets the information architecture: the pages and sections, in order, each with a one-line job tied to the conversion.
checks.rule: Output includes an information_architecture with ordered sections, each carrying a stated job; sections that do not move the conversion are cut.

checks.description: The UX flow runs click to page to signup gate to lifecycle, with the key states named.
checks.rule: Output includes a ux_flow from click through the signup gate into lifecycle and names states (first view, gate open, submitted, confirmed, error).

checks.description: Each wireframed view carries exactly one primary action.
checks.rule: Wireframe and hard rules state one primary action per view, not two competing CTAs.

checks.description: Copy-overlay slots are labeled by language (ar / en) and left empty; no copy is written here.
checks.rule: The web_asset_brief lists copy-overlay slots labeled ar or en and left empty; a hard rule forbids writing copy in this stream.

checks.description: Imagery direction is text-free; no Arabic is baked into a planned image.
checks.rule: Visual direction specifies text-free imagery and a hard rule forbids baking Arabic into a planned image.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals.

checks.description: Never imply accreditation; never invent Skill Path titles, instructor names, offers, or prices.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid accreditation implication and invented titles, names, offers, or prices.

checks.description: The output populates the direction fields of the web-design-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the information_architecture, ux_flow, wireframe, visual_direction, web_asset_brief, and conversion_intent fields of the web-design-package.
